summary: Override auto-resolved asks from the TUI, the web Alerts tab and iOS Now

replay.detail: Clients only read auto-resolved.list and send work.override; no claim kinds change. Web replay shows no Auto-resolved section.

schema.detail: Uses the client-v0 contract added by the auto-resolved read; no schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Each client lists the caller's auto-resolved asks with the applied default and offers the ask's other named answers. The override is hidden when the row carries no work.override parameter (the seven-day window closed). Daemons without the read show no section.

manual.detail: TUI: press o on an Auto-resolved or matching recently-closed row, pick an answer, Enter. Web: Alerts tab, Auto-resolved section. iOS: Now. Every client shows: Your answer replaces the default. Work already done on the default is not undone; <asker> is told.

recovery.detail: A refused override keeps the row and shows the refusal; retrying sends the same action id and key.
